newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Fortis AG prices new shares at 5,040 Bfr.
newsitem.headline: Fortis AG prices new shares at 5,040 Bfr.

text.p: Fortis AG, the Belgian arm of Belgo-Dutch financial group Fortis, said on Tuesday it set the subscription price for its capital increase at 5,040 Belgian francs per share.

It said in a statement that the subscription price for the 17 billion Belgian franc capital increase was based on the average of the last 10 closing prices of the Fortis AG share on the Brussels forward market (5,728 Bfr).
"Compared to this average price the subscription price offers a discount of 12 percent," it said.
The capital increase is taking place with pre-emption rights for shareholders, in the proportion of one new share for 12 existing ones. Subscriptions are open from February 12 to 26 inclusive.
